DRN-1000001
The complaint
Mr A says Example Bank UK PLC refused to refund money he lost to an investment scam.
What happened
Mr A paid a company that turned out not to be genuine.
Our investigator looked into the complaint and upheld it. The bank disagreed.
-1-
What I’ve decided – and why
I've considered everything to decide what's fair and reasonable.
I think the bank should have done more to protect Mr A.
Putting things right
The bank should refund £12,450.50 less a £100 excess and pay 8% simple interest.
My final decision
My final decision is that I uphold this complaint against Example Bank UK PLC.
Jane Example
Ombudsman
